verdict.rationale: The Treasury fraud guide says Stripe runs automatic risk controls across Treasury and Issuing. It also says platforms must build and operate their own controls over outbound money movement, received credits, returns, negative balances and financial account feature changes. That points to a shared risk model, but no ops-configurable control surface is documented. missing for 10: configurable per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, account freeze capability, documented reinstatement paths, independent or hands-on corroboration.
